title: Change of Plans
description: Dragging a shipment card to a different vehicle on the board should move it, not clone it, and a resolved conflict should actually disappear rather than lingering. Create a double-booking, then reassign one of the two shipments away from the conflict and verify it's fully resolved.
successCondition: After two assignments conflict on the same vehicle, calling PUT /api/fleet/assignments/:shipmentId again for one of them with a different, non-conflicting vehicleId results in exactly one assignment row for that shipment (not two), and GET /api/fleet/conflicts no longer reports that vehicle pairing.
hints: PUT is an upsert keyed by shipmentId — reassigning calls the same endpoint again with new vehicleId/driverId/time values.
Check the assignments table directly (or GET /api/fleet/assignments) to confirm there's only one row for the reassigned shipment, not a stale duplicate.
